doc.brief: Encapsulates context information that is required when drawing pages for printing.

create_pango_context.brief: Creates a new `PangoContext` that can be used with the `GtkPrintContext`.
create_pango_context.md:
Creates a new `PangoContext` that can be used with the
`GtkPrintContext`.

create_pango_layout.brief: Creates a new `PangoLayout` that is suitable for use with the `GtkPrintContext`.
create_pango_layout.md:
Creates a new `PangoLayout` that is suitable for use
with the `GtkPrintContext`.

get_cairo_context.brief: Obtains the cairo context that is associated with the `GtkPrintContext`.
get_cairo_context.md:
Obtains the cairo context that is associated with the
`GtkPrintContext`.

get_dpi_x.brief: Obtains the horizontal resolution of the `GtkPrintContext`, in dots per inch.
get_dpi_x.md:
Obtains the horizontal resolution of the `GtkPrintContext`,
in dots per inch.

get_dpi_y.brief: Obtains the vertical resolution of the `GtkPrintContext`, in dots per inch.
get_dpi_y.md:
Obtains the vertical resolution of the `GtkPrintContext`,
in dots per inch.

get_hard_margins.brief: Obtains the hardware printer margins of the `GtkPrintContext`, in units.
get_hard_margins.md:
Obtains the hardware printer margins of the `GtkPrintContext`,
in units.

get_height.brief: Obtains the height of the `GtkPrintContext`, in pixels.
get_height.md: Obtains the height of the `GtkPrintContext`, in pixels.

get_page_setup.brief: Obtains the `GtkPageSetup` that determines the page dimensions of the `GtkPrintContext`.
get_page_setup.md:
Obtains the `GtkPageSetup` that determines the page
dimensions of the `GtkPrintContext`.

get_pango_fontmap.brief: Returns a `PangoFontMap` that is suitable for use with the `GtkPrintContext`.
get_pango_fontmap.md:
Returns a `PangoFontMap` that is suitable for use
with the `GtkPrintContext`.

get_width.brief: Obtains the width of the `GtkPrintContext`, in pixels.
get_width.md: Obtains the width of the `GtkPrintContext`, in pixels.

set_cairo_context.brief: Sets a new cairo context on a print context.
set_cairo_context.md:
Sets a new cairo context on a print context.

This function is intended to be used when implementing
an internal print preview, it is not needed for printing,
since GTK itself creates a suitable cairo context in that
case.
